ex.t: 杂志中的文章通常很短，这使得孩子能够在不因注意力短暂而失去兴趣的情况下读完一篇专题文章。

ex.s: The articles in magazines are generally short, which allows a child to finish reading a feature article without losing interest due to short attention span.
ex.t: 通过让孩子从小就读杂志，你在鼓励发展一种有用的技能。___67___从小养成阅读期刊的习惯将培养持续到成年的阅读新闻文章的习惯。

ex.s: By allowing your child to read magazines at an early age, you are encouraging development of a useful skill. ___67___ Getting into the habit of reading periodicals as a child will foster the habit of reading news articles that may continue into adulthood.
ex.t: 当你的孩子看完杂志后鼓励他们把期刊传给兄弟姐妹或其他家庭成员。

ex.s: Reading magazines as a family can be used to introduce each other to the various interests that each family member possesses.
ex.t: 一旦每个家庭成员都读完了每本杂志，你可以把它们用于艺术和写作项目。

ex.s: Once each family member has finished reading each magazine, you can use them for art and writing projects.
